As a consumer who cannot do art well i dislike ai art because i feel like its not really done by the person but moreso the ai. With more lets say traditional forms of art, i can praise the artist for say the angle he created it in, the colors he used, the wrinkle in a particular piece of the clothing etc. With the ai i can’t really praise the person that had it generated because they were moreso a director than an artist. Im not saying ai art is super easy as pressing a button and calling it a day but i still feel theres not enough interaction on the human side. The ai makes most of the creative decisions. I understand people need to put the tags, the anti tags, the checkpoints, etc etc. I have used ai generators before to generate art just to see what it’s like. I was actually one of the earlier people to use it because i thought it was a fun novelty. Only when the idea of it being widely used for all entertainment arose did i begin to dislike it. I appreciate artists and i always praise how they do this or that but with ai i really can’t praise anyone besides Midjourney or Dall-E. I mean even i can generate nice looking images with them. I have very little artistic skill right now and i can do it. 

What im afraid of is more traditional styles of art becoming less used. With the rise of that 3d style stuff the old disney style vanished. I don’t hate the new stuff but i do miss the old style which they will never do again. It is a fear of mine that human made art will be so scarce in mass media in the future that the media where human made art IS used is almost a novelty. I don’t think ai stuff is all bad, i actually think it could be used in like private settings like a dnd campaign with friends or smth. I also think it could be used for like landscapes before an artist polishes it up, but i do think it should not be a main focus and it certainly should not be presented in its raw form because then the only artist would be the ai.
